The second allowed difference is the 32-byte GNU build-ID payload of the proper 48-byte .note.gnu.build-id output. Recompute both BLAKE3 IDs independently using released Wild semantics; reciprocal whole-file SHA-256 reconstruction and a streamed raw equality check outside the two proven fields are mandatory. Reject every other type, attribute, field, note, changed width, exit, test-list or program version.
